```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(lubridate)
```

# Load data

```{r}
bryte <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//bryte_near_others.xlsx")
menlo <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//menlo_near_others.xlsx")
ucd <- read_excel("data//bespoke_datasets//ucd_near_others.xlsx")
basemap <- st_read("data//shapefiles//WW_Delta.shp")
```

# narrow where timeframes are within 1 week and locations are appropriate for comparison

```{r}
bryte_filtered <- bryte %>%
  filter(abs(as.numeric(difftime(
    bryte_date, otherlab_date, units = "days"
  ))) <= 5) 

#Check to see that matched samples are realistic (filter to where assigned place names are different)
bryte_filtered_diffs <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(!bryte_placename == otherlab_placename) %>% select(OBJECTID, bryte_placename, bryte_latitude, bryte_longitude, otherlab_placename, otherlab_latitude, otherlab_longitude)
bryte_filtered_diffs

bryte_pts <- st_as_sf(
  bryte_filtered_diffs,
  coords = c("bryte_longitude", "bryte_latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

otherlab_pts <- st_as_sf(
  bryte_filtered_diffs,
  coords = c("otherlab_longitude", "otherlab_latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

bryte_pts <- st_transform(bryte_pts, 4326)
otherlab_pts <- st_transform(otherlab_pts, 4326)
basemap <- st_transform(basemap, 4326)

leaflet() %>%
addPolygons(
  data = basemap,
  color = "darkblue",
  fillColor = "lightblue",
  fillOpacity = 0.3,
  weight = 1
)%>%

  # UCD sampling locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = bryte_pts,
    color = "blue",
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
  label = ~paste(bryte_placename, " | ID:", OBJECTID),
  popup = ~paste(
    "<b>Place:</b>", bryte_placename,
    "<br><b>OBJECTID:</b>", OBJECTID
  )
  ) %>%

  # Other lab sampling locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = otherlab_pts,
    color = "red",
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
  label = ~paste(otherlab_placename, " | ID:", OBJECTID),
  popup = ~paste(
    "<b>Place:</b>", otherlab_placename,
    "<br><b>OBJECTID:</b>", OBJECTID
  )
  ) 

#List of inappropriate comparisons: 16708, 16577, 14873
bryte_filtered <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(!OBJECTID == 16708) %>%
    filter(!OBJECTID == 16577)%>%
    filter(!OBJECTID == 14873)
```

# Explore

```{r}
#Menlo
ggplot(menlo_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = menlo_chl_ugl, color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(menlo_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(menlo_chl_ugl), color = otherlab_lab)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#Regression with nwql_cbl looks dang near perfect, UCD looks offset. Only 1 Bryte sample, can't compare. 

menlo_v_cawsc <- menlo_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "nwql_cbl")

m_v_c <- t.test(menlo_v_cawsc$menlo_chl_ugl, menlo_v_cawsc$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
m_v_c#not different!!!

menlo_v_ucd <- menlo_filtered %>% filter(otherlab_lab == "ucd")

m_v_u <- t.test(menlo_v_ucd$menlo_chl_ugl, menlo_v_ucd$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
m_v_u #oof, these are different. 
```

#Because they are certainly compatible, let's combine all USGS data to make a more robust comparison dataset for Bryte and UCD samples.

```{r}
bryte_filtered <- bryte_filtered %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(otherlab_lab == "ucd", "ucd", "usgs"))
ucd_filtered <- ucd_filtered %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(otherlab_lab == "bryte", "bryte", "usgs"))

```

```{r}
#Bryte
# Plot regression, color by group
ggplot(bryte_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = bryte_chl_ugl, color = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(bryte_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(bryte_chl_ugl), color = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#There are only enough data points fo compare Bryte data to USGS data.

bryte_v_cawsc <- bryte_filtered %>% filter(group == "usgs")

b_v_c <-t.test(bryte_v_cawsc$bryte_chl_ugl, bryte_v_cawsc$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
#not diff
```


```{r}
# UCD

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(ucd_chl_ugl), color = group)) +
```

#Create clean results table
```{r}

results <- bind_rows(

  tidy(b_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Bryte",
           lab2 = "NWQL, CBL, Menlo",
           N = sum(complete.cases(bryte_v_cawsc))),

  tidy(m_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Menlo",
           lab2 = "NWQL and CBL",
           N = sum(complete.cases(menlo_v_cawsc))),

  tidy(m_v_u) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "Menlo",
           lab2 = "UCD",
           N = sum(complete.cases(menlo_v_ucd))),

  tidy(u_v_c) %>%
    mutate(lab1 = "UCD",
           lab2 = "NWQL, CBL, Menlo",
           N = sum(complete.cases(ucd_v_cawsc)))

) %>%
  select(lab1, lab2, N, estimate, statistic, parameter,
         p.value, conf.low, conf.high, method)

results
```

# The Menlo v UCD comparison anre the only different one. The issue may be the low N. Since the other comparisons are not different. let's combine all other labs to compare similar spacetime UCD measurements. 


```{r}
u_v_all <- t.test(ucd_filtered$ucd_chl_ugl, ucd_filtered$otherlab_chl_ugl, paired = TRUE) 
u_v_all # still different. 

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = otherlab_chl_ugl, y = ucd_chl_ugl)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ucd_filtered, aes(x = log(otherlab_chl_ugl), y = log(ucd_chl_ugl))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#Still flatline in regression. Does not appear to be correctable. Relatively low values but at the 1 to 5is range, there should be a trend and certainly not a flatline.
```


```{r}
# Explore UCD data ranges in similar locs/season/years
ds_data <- read.csv("data//bespoke_datasets//ds_data_by_lab_20261014ER.csv")

ucd_all <- ds_data %>%
  filter(lab == "ucd") %>%
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date),
    my = paste0(month, year)
  )

latmin = min(ucd_all$latitude)
latmax = max(ucd_all$latitude)
longmin = min(ucd_all$longitude)
longmax = max(ucd_all$longitude)
mylist = unique(ucd_all$my)

ds_ucd_filter <- ds_data  %>%
    mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date),
    my = paste0(month, year)) %>%
    filter(
    latitude >= latmin,
    latitude <= latmax,
    longitude >= longmin,
    longitude <=longmax,
    my %in% mylist) 

    
testing_pts <- st_as_sf(
  ds_ucd_filter,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

lab_palette <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("red", "blue", "darkgreen", "purple"),
  domain = testing_pts$lab
)

leaflet() %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = basemap,
    color = "darkblue",
    fillColor = "lightblue",
    fillOpacity = 0.3,
    weight = 1
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = testing_pts,
    color = ~lab_palette(as.character(lab)),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8
  )

#Too differnt in location ranges to compare broadly with ANOVAs. I want to pivot and correct the sonde data and compare to discretes, maybe we'll have more UCD data comparisons. 
```

# Let's compare ds to sensor data now

```{r}
# Reminder that these sensor data have been corrected.
ds_near_sensor <- read.csv("data//bespoke_datasets//ds_near_sensor_20261112ER.csv")

#usbr data were not comparable, so remove
ds_near_sensor <- ds_near_sensor %>% filter(!ds_group == "usbr")

#My computer can't handle plotting the mismatch placenames (there are over 200, but there are still plenty that do match. I will just filter to only include matching waterway names.)
ds_near_sensor <- ds_near_sensor %>% filter(ds_loc == sensor_loc) 

ggplot(ds_near_sensor, aes(x = ds_chl_ug_l, y = sensor_chl_ug_l, color = sensor_group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ds_near_sensor, aes(x = log(ds_chl_ug_l), y = log(sensor_chl_ug_l), color = sensor_group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

###Try filtering chl less than 50, there are some outrageous values here.

ds_near_sensor_less50 <- ds_near_sensor %>% filter(ds_chl_ug_l <= 50) 
ggplot(ds_near_sensor_less50, aes(x = ds_chl_ug_l, y = sensor_chl_ug_l, color = sensor_group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ds_near_sensor_less50, aes(x = log(ds_chl_ug_l), y = log(sensor_chl_ug_l), color = sensor_group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
usgs_ds_near_sensor_less50 <- ds_near_sensor_less50 %>% filter(sensor_group == "usgs_cawsc") 
ds_v_usgs <- t.test((usgs_ds_near_sensor_less50$ds_chl_ug_l),(usgs_ds_near_sensor_less50$sensor_chl_ug_l), paired = TRUE) 
ds_v_usgs

cemp_ds_near_sensor_less50 <- ds_near_sensor_less50 %>% filter(sensor_group == "dwr_cemp") 
ds_v_cemp <- t.test((cemp_ds_near_sensor_less50$ds_chl_ug_l), (cemp_ds_near_sensor_less50$sensor_chl_ug_l), paired = TRUE)

ncro_ds_near_sensor_less50 <- ds_near_sensor_less50 %>% filter(sensor_group == "dwr_ncro") 
ds_v_ncro <- t.test((ncro_ds_near_sensor_less50$ds_chl_ug_l), (ncro_ds_near_sensor_less50$sensor_chl_ug_l), paired = TRUE)
```
